finalText:
All 625 cases pass and `verify.js` confirms the fix is legitimate (not a spec/runner hack).

**The bug:** `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` computed tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount — its own doc comment said "discount first, then tax on discounted amount," but the code taxed `cents` instead of `discounted`. Fixed to `applyTax(discounted, taxRate)`. Only the 3 test rows that had both a nonzero discount and nonzero tax exposed it, which is why it was buried in the noise.
